Comtrade data

Source: R/amen-package.R
comtrade.Rd

Ten years (1996 to 2005) of bilateral trade among 30 countries in six SITC Rev. 1 commodity classes aggregated at the first level (AG1).

Format

A four-way array of dimension 30 x 30 x 6 x 10 (exporter, importer, commodity class, year) with dimnames giving the country names, the classes (chemicals; crude materials, inedible, except fuels; food and live animals; machinery and transport equipment; manufactured goods classified chiefly by material; miscellaneous manufactured articles) and the years. Each value is the change from the previous year in the natural logarithm of exports measured in 2000 US dollars. For example, the 1996 slice records changes from 1995 to 1996. Values are growth measures, not log levels or raw trade volumes; negative values indicate decreases. The 1,800 missing cells are the within-country diagonals. The first index is the reporting (exporting) country.

Source

Hoff, P. D. (2011), Section 4 of Separable covariance arrays via the Tucker product, with applications to multivariate relational data, doi:10.1214/11-BA606 . Original processed array: https://www2.stat.duke.edu/~pdh10/Code/hoff_2011_ba/. Underlying trade and inflation data: https://comtrade.un.org/, https://www.measuringworth.com/
